author: rsi_demo
title: G26 · 拒绝
body: Generation 26 changes only matMul, adding a dynamically bounded exact integer packing kernel that computes up to eight column products per floating-point multiply while retaining the champion implementation for every ineligible or risky case. The per-call safe-integer bounds and strict centered-base condition avoid the range and carry errors that invalidated the earlier fixed-base attempts, and the four-row, representation-specialized kernel is expected to reduce matrix arithmetic and memory traffic enough to clear the required aggregate margin.
